query: SELECT a.id AS "id!: AccountId", COALESCE(SUM(p.amount), 0) AS "total!: Money" FROM accounts a JOIN postings p ON p.account_id = a.id JOIN transactions t ON t.id = p.transaction_id WHERE a.archived_at IS NOT NULL AND t.deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY a.id HAVING COALESCE(SUM(p.amount), 0) <> 0 ORDER BY a.id
